children: Belgium’s trade surplus widened to a record EUR 6,479.3 million in July 2026, from EUR 2,718.6 million in the same month a year earlier.
Exports rose 4.6% year-on-year to EUR 46,295.8 million, driven by higher shipments to EU member states (3.4%) and non-EU countries (7.1%).
Meanwhile, imports declined 4.2% to EUR 39,816.5 million, reflecting a 17.2% drop in purchases from non-EU countries.
In contrast, imports from EU member states increased 5.3%.
For the first seven months of the year, Belgium’s trade surplus widened sharply to EUR 31,354.2 million, compared with EUR 14,293.7 million in the corresponding period a year earlier.

title: Belgium Trade Surplus Widens to Record High
